updates.title: Windows Active Directory Domain Services Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
updates.summary: A command injection vulnerability in Windows Active Directory Domain Services (CVE-2026-49179) allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code remotely over the network. Admins should prioritize patching this critical identity infrastructure vulnerability to prevent unauthorized code execution on domain controllers.

updates.title: Microsoft SharePoint Server Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: Improper authentication in SharePoint Server (CVE-2026-62827) allows an authorized attacker to escalate privileges over the network. Organizations should apply patches immediately to prevent lateral movement and unauthorized access within SharePoint environments.

updates.title: Microsoft SharePoint Server Tampering Vulnerability
updates.summary: Incorrect authorization logic in SharePoint Server (CVE-2026-63512) allows an authorized attacker to tamper with content over the network. This vulnerability may expose organizations to unauthorized modifications of sensitive business data and compliance records.

updates.title: Windows Hello for Business and macOS Platform SSO as MFA Second Factor
updates.summary: Windows Hello for Business and macOS Platform SSO can now serve as standalone second factors for multifactor authentication, eliminating the need for users to register separate passkeys for step-up authentication and sign-in frequency checks. This improves user experience while maintaining phishing-resistant authentication for conditional access and authentication strength policies.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Granular Classification Error Controls for Exchange Online
updates.summary: Administrators can now create granular DLP policies in Exchange Online that respond to specific classification or text extraction failure types (timeout, throttling, etc.) rather than applying a single blanket policy to all scan errors. This enables more precise DLP enforcement and reduces false positives in email protection.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Count of Labeled Documents Condition for Exchange Online
updates.summary: A new DLP condition for Exchange Online policies allows admins to trigger rules based on the count of sensitivity-labeled attachments in an email, enabling detection of bulk data exfiltration attempts where multiple sensitive files collectively pose a compliance risk. This addresses scenarios where individual attachments may appear low-risk but collectively indicate unauthorized data transfer.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Reusable Global List for Exchange Online
updates.summary: Centralized keyword, domain, and email address lists eliminate duplication across DLP rules, reducing maintenance overhead for organizations managing large-scale policies. This streamlines policy management and ensures consistency across Exchange Online protection rules.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: User-Based Aggregation of DLP Alerts
updates.summary: DLP alerts can now be consolidated by user across multiple matched rules, reducing alert noise and simplifying investigation workflows. This enhancement helps security teams focus on the most relevant violations rather than processing redundant alerts for the same user.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP: FTP and SFTP Protection
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP now supports monitoring and protecting sensitive data transferred via FTP and SFTP from managed endpoints, extending data protection beyond modern cloud protocols. This enables organizations to maintain visibility and control over legacy file transfer methods used in their environments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP: AI-Powered Policy Sync and Device Health Investigation
updates.summary: An AI-powered visibility and diagnostic feature tracks Endpoint DLP policy deployment health across devices, identifying sync failures with root cause analysis and recommended remediation actions. This accelerates troubleshooting of policy deployment issues and improves overall enforcement coverage.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP: Faster Policy Sync Status Reporting (30 min SLA)
updates.summary: Admins can now view Endpoint DLP policy sync status in the Purview portal within 30 minutes instead of 2 hours, providing faster visibility into deployment success or failure. This reduction in reporting latency helps admins more quickly identify and remediate policy enforcement gaps.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery: In-Product Diagnostics for Troubleshooting
updates.summary: Self-service diagnostics tools in eDiscovery help admins identify and resolve common configuration issues around case permissions, security filters, and policy status without escalating to support. This embedded troubleshooting capability reduces friction when managing eDiscovery cases and legal holds.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery (Premium): Hold Reports
updates.summary: Out-of-the-box reporting for legal holds in eDiscovery cases allows admins to sort, filter, and download aggregated hold information across all cases in the Purview compliance portal. This streamlines legal hold tracking and reporting for compliance and litigation teams.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Hard Delete for OneDrive and SharePoint
updates.summary: Compliance admins can now configure retention policies to permanently delete content in OneDrive and SharePoint through secure priority cleanup workflows, enabling stricter enforcement of data retention and deletion requirements. Hard delete capabilities must be carefully configured to avoid inadvertent data loss, as content is no longer recoverable from recycle bins.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Network Data Security with Global Secure Access Integration
updates.summary: DLP integration with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access enables organizations to intercept and inspect text and AI interactions at the network layer, enforcing DLP policies on traffic to untrusted cloud apps and generative AI platforms. This addresses data exfiltration risks through browsers, APIs, and add-ins by combining network-layer inspection with insider risk detection.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: Unified Alert Experience
updates.summary: A single unified alerts dashboard consolidates Triage Agent and Standard alert workflows, allowing analysts to preview agent summaries and user details directly on the alerts list without switching views. This reduces friction in alert management and improves investigation efficiency.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: Expanded User Profile Details
updates.summary: User profile information in the unified alert experience now includes Microsoft Entra signals such as office location, employee type, department, and last working date, enriching context for insider risk investigations. This integration improves analyst capability to assess user risk signals with organizational context.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: Expanded Note Capabilities
updates.summary: Analysts can now add and view notes on both alerts and cases, with system-generated notes automatically applied for status changes, assignments, closures, and escalations. This enhances documentation and collaboration during insider risk investigations.
